ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Moli listens when you talk to it (microphone button or “Talk to Moli”).
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Moli uses your location to know whether you are home, and adapt the house (lights, alarm, heating). It is only sent to your own Moli, at home.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: To know when you arrive home or leave, even with the app closed, Moli needs your location in the background. It is only sent to your own Moli, at home.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Moli talks to your house over the home Wi-Fi, at the address you give it.
